images.description: Pictures attached to this message. Each is a REFERENCE to a file in the documents directory beside the ledger, never the bytes themselves: the ledger is one JSON object per line and read line by line, and an inlined image would put megabytes of base64 on a line that every reader has to walk past. Absent means none, which is what every record written before attachments existed says.

file.description: Bare file name in the documents directory, content-addressed. Never a path — a reference that could name ../.. would make a ledger a way to read arbitrary files.

mediaType.description: IANA media type, e.g. image/png. What a dialect needs to declare the block to its provider.

name.description: What the person called it, for display only. The file name is the identity.
